result.summary: The page is generally well-structured and visually coherent, but there are a few layout and content issues: the 'Trattoria Piccol...' restaurant name is truncated without a clear affordance, the bottom navigation bar overlaps with the device home indicator causing a visual clash, and the horizontal category carousel and 'Fastest near you' row are cut off at the right edge without a visible scroll hint.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' in the 'Fastest near you' horizontal row is truncated mid-word with an ellipsis, and the card itself is cut off at the right screen edge.
issues.suggestion: Allow the card to be fully visible when scrolled, and consider a two-line title or smaller font so the full restaurant name can be read without truncation.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar overlaps with the system home indicator (the horizontal black bar), making the search and bookmark icons appear crossed by a line and reducing tap-target clarity.
issues.suggestion: Add safe-area bottom padding so the navigation icons sit above the home indicator and remain clearly tappable.

issues.description: The category filter carousel ('All', 'Pizza', 'Sushi', 'Burgers', 'Healthy') and the 'Fastest near you' card row are clipped at the right edge with no visible scroll indicator or fade-out hint.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle gradient fade or partial next-item peek to signal that the rows are horizontally scrollable.
